conclusion_own_confidence: SFT native dev/test predictions contain no per-sample own confidence signal (no logprob, no entropy, no marginal score). The eval script uses greedy generation and does not store output_scores/return_dict_in_generate. Without a stored native confidence, a dev-fit threshold curve is not available offline, and ReGate head probabilities are not a valid stand-in for a native confidence.

groundingme_external.evidence: GroundingME dataset (CVPR 2026, arXiv:2512.17495, github.com/lirang04/GroundingME, HF lirang04/GroundingME).

openref_external.evidence: OpenRef val.json-derived single-pair referring-expression diagnostic (500 pairs), prepared by prepare_openref.py.

run_config.parallelism: 2 data-parallel ranks, each using 2-way HF model sharding
run_config.vision_preprocessing: Each JSONL row carries metadata.vision_max_pixels=16777216. eval_qwen3vl_3reason.py transfers this into the image content consumed by qwen_vl_utils, so the cap is effective and aspect ratio is preserved.
run_config.negative_scoring: Any valid abstention is correct; wrong_object/no_target reason is not scored.

baseline_protocol_check.conclusion: The existing groundingme/openref outputs run the paper's own base/SFT/ReGate models on external benchmark-derived probes. They are NOT CounterfactualREC / GREC / RECANTFormer runs and are not a same-protocol comparison for those methods. The review statement that the same-protocol comparison for those methods remains to be supplemented still holds.
